# Adrift gizmo

`Gizmo: giz-adrift` `LIVE`

## What it does

Nothing, unsoundly. Its section names a gizmo its field does not, which is the mirroring check reporting in the
direction the ADR fixture above does not exercise.

## Dependencies

None, and the graph is wrong: it reaches [giz-mirrored](mirrored.md) all the same. Written as prose rather than as a
bullet, because inlines hang off a leaf block and a section walk that descends from the block itself finds the links in
a list and none of the links in a paragraph.
